holder-quote: I sigh, but smile at her. Durene perks back up.
Yes, Durene told me all about it. [Quick Strike]’s a basic move. It’s more common to get [Power Strike] and move from there, but Durene’s strong enough.
Durene lashes out with her shield and Beniar sways back. The shield misses him and he grins. He’s taking a step back when Durene shouts.
effect-quote: Her arm blurs. I hear Beniar’s voice and a thud almost at the same time.
